# EVGA Hardware RMA & Return Policy Guidelines **Document Reference:** EVGA-WARR-SOP-2024 **Applies To:** EVGA Graphics Cards, Motherboards, Power Supplies & RMA Replacements ---

1. RMA Return Windows & Types * **Standard RMA:** Customer ships the defective unit to the EVGA distribution hub. Upon physical inspection and receipt verification, a replacement unit is dispatched within 3 business days. * **Advanced Cross-Shipment RMA (EAR):** Available for registered Tier 2 and Tier 3 original purchasers. A collateral hold is placed on a credit card, and replacement hardware ships immediately prior to receiving the returned unit. * **Direct 30-Day Refund:** Applies exclusively to items purchased directly from the EVGA Store. Must be in pristine, unopened condition. ---

2. Mandatory Packaging & Shipping Standards Returned hardware must be packaged in compliance with industrial electrostatic discharge (ESD) and transit protection standards: 1. **Antistatic Protection:** Hardware must be sealed within an approved ESD-safe antistatic protective bag. 2. **Cushioning:** Must have at least two inches (5 cm) of dense protective foam or bubble wrap surrounding all sides. Do not use loose foam peanuts. 3. **PCIe & Connector Protection:** The plastic PCIe slot protector and video port dust caps must be reinstalled if available. 4. **Transit Damage Liability:** If a package arrives damaged due to improper consumer packaging, the RMA claim will be rejected and transferred to the shipping carrier as customer liability. ---

3. Physical Inspection & RMA Void Conditions Upon intake, units undergo mechanical, optical, and electrical testing: * **Physical Damage:** Any cracked PCB, chipped GPU core, or bent bracket voids standard replacement. * **Burn Marks:** Electrical burn marks on VRM chokes or melted power connector pins are not covered under limited warranty. * **Serial Number:** The serial number label affixed to the backplate must remain clean, legible, and unremoved. ---

4. High-Value Escalation Escrow (Tier 4 Returns) For enterprise units and graphics cards valued above $2,500: * Automated auto-approval is permanently disabled. * Units undergo mandatory forensic laboratory teardown and microscopic X-ray inspection. * Replacement or credit release is authorized only upon Senior Quality Assurance sign-off.
